The '''Callia sector''' was on the outer periphery of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]; a short trip from [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Vaxal]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Adria Reyn]] ruled the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Polyhedron" />
